turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My partner wants a ceiling fan in the bedroom and I'm the handy one apparently.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Ha, congratulations. Is there already a light fitting up there you'd replace, or would it need new wiring?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One sec, I'm going to talk with my neighbor. Please wait until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey Leo, are we still on for the Saturday bootcamp in the park, the one with the hill sprints?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Ugh, I forgot I said yes to that.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: You were so excited on Monday.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Monday me is very brave. Saturday me wants pancakes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We can get pancakes after. Will you come if I drive?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Fine, but if I collapse on the hill, you carry me down.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll bring water and sympathy. Mostly water.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Great. Pick me up at nine.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. That ceiling fan. Replacing the light, or running new wires?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No fitting at all. New wiring.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then I'd get an electrician for the wiring part. You can still do the assembly.
